latest_release.name: .NET 10.0.15
latest_release.body:
[Release](https://github.com/dotnet/core/releases/tag/v10.0.15)

## What's Changed
* [release/10.0] Unify native API availability probes by @akoeplinger in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/134329
* [release/10.0][browser][mono] Make sure we treat the 4GB ptrs as unsigned by @lewing in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/131361
* [release/10.0] Ensure type loader templates for interface dispatch cells by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/134821
* [release/10.0] Fix NoopLimiter disposal in DefaultPartitionedRateLimiter Heartbeat by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/133647
* [release/10.0] Fix NativeAOT EventPipe use-after-free by waiting for active writers by @MichalStrehovsky with @Copilot in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/134999
* [release/10.0] Allow variable page sizes in codesign output in Microsoft.NET.HostModel.Tests by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/134599
* [release/10.0] Fix build error with latest MSVC by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135053
* [release/10.0] Fix Linux FileSystemWatcher silent stop after unpaired IN_MOVED_FROM by @adamsitnik with @Copilot in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/133487
* [release/10.0] [CreateDump] Use _exit after createdump launch failures by @mdh1418 in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135123
* [release/10.0] Fix msl wait time extraction in GC by @janvorli in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135228
* [release/10.0] JIT: handle redefined enumerators in conditional escape analysis by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/134710
* [release/10.0] Fix negative tmp-buffer size in vxsort align_vectorized by @janvorli in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135230
* [release/10.0] OpenSSL 4 support by @vcsjones in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135534
* Update MsQuic to 2.5.11 to unblock release/10.0 builds by @bartonjs in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135579
* [release/10.0] Handle TAR uid/gid values larger than int.MaxValue by @rzikm in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135478
* [release/10.0] Fix Duplicate ownership state machine under concurrency for NCrypt handles by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135436
* [release/10.0] Update dependencies from dotnet/xharness by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/134322
* [release/10.0] Update dependencies from dotnet/runtime-assets by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/134562
* [release/10.0] Update dependencies from dotnet/icu by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/133926
* [release/10.0] Preserve module initialization across ReadyToRun inlining by @AaronRobinsonMSFT in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135376
* [release/10.0] Fix software EH memory leak on Unix by @janvorli in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135546
* [release/10.0] Fix operator precedence bug in SystemNative_FSync causing silent fsync errors by @adamsitnik with @Copilot in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135261
* [release/10.0] Fix Dragon4 shortest formatting for exact powers of two by @tannergooding in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135614
* [release/10.0] Remove unused client certificate from TLS host resumption test by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135633
* [release/10.0] Fix direct thread-static alignment fallback by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/135104
* [release/10.0] Fix MemoryCache negative _cacheSize drift that permanently latches a size-limited cache by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/129510


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/compare/v10.0.13...v10.0.15
